Story: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
Summary: Ordered to bow to Nebuchadnezzar's golden image, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refused, declaring God was able to save them — but even if He did not, they would not bow. Thrown into a furnace heated seven times hotter, they were seen walking unbound with a fourth figure, and emerged without even the smell of fire.
Significance: Their 'but even if He does not' is faith at its bravest. Whether God delivers us from the fire or in it, He walks with His people there — and that is our anchor.
